scope: Held-out years 2022-07..2026-06 (Rahu-Mars, Jupiter-Jupiter, Jupiter-Saturn to 2026-06-30). Wording anonymised. Contamination caveat applies: rule support may be inflated by a predictor who recognised the subject.

rules.finding: Mercury and Venus pratyantars in this window all carried career/capital gains (Jan 2023 investment, spring 2023 testimony, autumn 2024 raise, spring 2026 raise/deals). Jupiter-Jupiter was the career peak AD.
rules.revision: Add: career-strong is not reputation-safe; see N-03 for Mercury.

rules.finding: Both Saturn pratyantars inside strong ADs delivered forced restructuring ending upward (removal and return 2023; corporate restructuring 2025). The third Saturn pratyantar (late 2022) held a breakthrough launch instead of pressure, consistent with the rule's technology clause rather than its setback clause.
No ending while Saturn stayed out of Libra; instead a marriage. Only negatively tested.

Sponsors and boards remained the channel for both rise and crisis (patron rescue in 2023, new sponsors 2025). But the strained former co-sponsor tie escalated to multi-year litigation and a jury trial, which the rule (and the back-test note that conflicts are sponsor fights, not lawsuits) excluded.
rules.revision: Patron and co-founder ties strain under malefic sub-periods and, from the Jupiter MD onward, can escalate to formal litigation; outcomes favour the native (nr-04b).

rules.finding: Every money signal showed as institutional capital (raises, megadeals, IPO filing). Personal money surfaced only as a pledge to give it away (ev-110) and a donation (ev-127).

The Venus clause held (no Venus timing). But the rule's 'no formal marriage' framing was overtaken: a public couple appearance, a stated plan for children and a marriage came under the Jupiter MD start with transit Jupiter on the lagna aspecting the 7th and 5th, and a child followed under Jupiter over the Moon.
rules.revision: Partnership formalisation is timed by Jupiter (MD/AD start plus transit Jupiter aspecting the 7th), not Venus; read the non-conventional path as the form, not as absence of commitment.

rules.finding: No health event of his own; health-tagged items are self-reports or threats in which he was unhurt.
rules.revision: Note that physical-security threats can appear (N-01) without bodily harm.

rules.finding: Visibility clause held: the public peak came exactly with Rahu then Jupiter on the lagna. Ketu clause failed as a timer: both Ketu pratyantars (mid-2024, mid-2026) missed the departures by weeks and the second held an IPO filing.
rules.revision: Keep the visibility requirement; drop Ketu pratyantars as departure/delegation timers (AD-level only).

rules.finding: MD seam 2023-07-07: the defining break came +4.5 months. AD seam 2025-08-24: restructuring completed +2 months.
Childhood-only rule; no bearing on the held-out years.

The Jupiter-Jupiter-Moon pratyantar (with Jupiter over the Moon) brought the sibling lawsuit (3 days early), counterclaims and a birth. The Rahu-Mars-Moon pratyantar gave no sibling turbulence (1 of 2).
rules.revision: Severity can reach magnitude 5 (litigation); do not cap family turbulence at low weight.

rules.finding: Saturn pratyantars 2 of 3 (the third was a breakthrough, not a setback); Mars 1 of 1 (low magnitude); Jupiter 0 of 2 clean (one miss by a month, one mixed launch).
rules.revision: Saturn and Mars pratyantar timing is reliable; Jupiter pratyantar timing is not. Saturn pratyantars give restructuring (sign depends on the AD), not necessarily setbacks.

rules.finding: Moon clause held (lots bought in the Moon pratyantar with Jupiter over the Moon). Jupiter-in-Cancer clause failed in its short windows: a listing for sale and then attacks on the home.
rules.revision: Keep the Moon activation; demote brief Jupiter ingresses into Cancer, and check Saturn in the 12th first (N-01).

newRules.rule: Saturn transiting the 12th over natal 12th-house planets that include the 6th lord brings exposure to hidden or unknown adversaries (including threats to the residence) and heavy outflows, while the native escapes bodily harm.
A Saturn pratyantar falling while Rahu transits the lagna can deliver a technology breakthrough rather than a setback (Saturn as 8th-house research significator).
Mercury (3rd/6th lord, D10 10th) pratyantars in strong ADs give career gains together with public accusations and disputes: expect both.
newRules.note: Two of two Mercury pratyantars in the Jupiter MD so far.

newRules.rule: Sun pratyantars (exalted Sun in the lagna) bring direct engagement with heads of state or ruling power.
newRules.note: Two instances (heads-of-state tour in Rahu-Mars-Sun; inaugural donation in Jupiter-Jupiter-Sun).
